component.name: GitScope
component.summary: GitHub analytics on your Linux desktop

description.p: GitScope is a Linux desktop application for exploring, analyzing and tracking public GitHub projects. It searches repositories, users and organizations, compares projects side by side, follows releases of a personal watchlist and inspects activity, commits, contributors and language composition.

Settings, daily snapshots, notifications and cached responses are stored in a local SQLite database, so previously fetched data stays available when GitHub is unreachable. Signing in uses a scopeless classic personal access token or OAuth Device Flow; the token never leaves the machine.
First release assembled by the automated pipeline: continuous integration on every push and tag-triggered builds that attach deb, rpm and AppImage bundles alongside the standalone executable.

Token connection classifies rejected tokens precisely, the token is stored in the local SQLite database without the system secret store, and the token dialog opens the classic token creation form with every scope unchecked.
